title: Glycemia history graph - no detailed view possible back in the past
body:
Discussed in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/2410

**Subject of the issue**

It seems that there is something wrong in glycemia history graph view, I can see a full detail history only for 30 days back and then each one day more back is almost twice short in detailed view (with no possibility to extend).

I went through the Nightly releases chain and Nightly build 3rd Aug 2022, stable, https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/e13a76ec2a89c287a9d61171e7c79e01b632c0de-2022.08.03 is the last version that is ok. 
Next Nightly build 18th Aug 2022, https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/c649f9de2ba7c8fc5929ccad3d8c5526a937db3b-2022.08.18., has started the issue in glycemia history graph view.

**Environment**
I have tested with different mobiles (Android 9) and different data source (i.e. historical data was taken from G6, Libre1/MM1, Libre follower) with the same results.

**Why is needed**
We use notes (description of foods, activity, etc.) with combination of glycemia history graph to see what was reaction to some kind of foods/activity.

comments.body: I am testing a fix for this issue and will update when ready for wider testing. Hopefully only a few days.
Please try the Nov 5th nightly to see if it resolves the problem. thanks

LG G5 running Android 8 with Dexcom G6 in native mode
